snippet.title: Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double - Release Trailer (Steam/App Store/Google Play)
snippet.description:
This is an immersive adventure game based on the urban legend of the "double", where anyone could be replaced by someone that looks exactly like them. Who and what will you place your trust in...?
Now on Steam, the App Store, and Google Play! https://playism.com/en/game/ulh2/

The Story
Chris, a popular Utuber who runs a channel about urban legends, has mysteriously disappeared, causing a buzz of discussion on the internet. The protagonist coincidentally comes across a crucial clue that could help solve this case and ends up working with the other channel members to find Chris and seek out the truth.

Soon, they learn of an urban legend where a person gets replaced by a perfect copy of themself—the double, and that it's heavily connected to this mystery... 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651290/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1542078553
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.toii.doppelganger

Developer: Toii Games
Publisher: PLAYISM
